item.tib: na rag pang kong smon lam
item.coloph: de nas rim par brgyud nas mkhas pa mi bzhi'i dus nas/ bskal pa'i rlung gi nyi zla 'char nub 'ong ba bzhin/ gri rum btsan po'i ring la g.yung drung gi bon nub ste/ gshen po rnams bod yul du bzhugs pa ma bde ste/ g.yung drung gi bon rin po che gter mdzad du gsal lo/ de dus dmu tsa gyer med dang / ra sang khod ram gyis gsang brag rgya bo'i g.yon zur gyis sog po khros pa 'dra ba'i brag la sgrub skor gting rdzogs ma bu sdeb skor dang / na rag pang skong rgyal po dang*/ mkhon sbyangs la sogs sbas/ yum sras lnga la gtad do ma shor cig nam zhig dus kyi tha ma la/ nyi zla nub yang 'char ba bzhin/ smon lam mthu brtsan gcig gis ni nyi shar bzhin du gdams ngag len/ sgrub gshen rnams kyi nyams grib sel/ de nas kun du 'phel ba'i rgyud lags so/ u ya ag tham smar ro//
